thread:
sre-bot: ALERT: High p99 latency and reduced throughput detected for API routes /v1/chat/completions and /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1. Impact: intermittent 5-15s tails, increased queueing. Paging oncall @Anna M (oncall) :rotating_light:
Anna M (oncall): Seeing the page, logging in to dash now. Any customer-facing notices yet?
sre-bot: Incidence detected at 1768001098, anomaly score 98. Autoscale attempted 2x with limited effect. Error spike: HTTP 504s from inference gateways.
Anna M (oncall): Kicking off basic checks: 1) instance health 2) gate logs 3) autoscaler. @Jason SRE can you join?
Jason SRE: On it, joining. Initial read: GPU saturation on a subset of dedicated pools serving large-context chat models. Some nodes at 98% mem + 95% util.
Oliver Eng: Noted — model v2025-chat-large has significantly longer tokenization step for some inputs; might be causing backpressure.
Priya PM: Any customer impact list? Are production customers experiencing errors or just latency?
support-agent: We have 3 incoming tickets from customers in EU reporting timeouts on batch embed jobs and slow chat responses. No major churn yet but tickets are heating up.
Anna M (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: A) reroute a fraction of traffic to eu-west-2 (if capacity), B) enable degraded model variant (v2025-chat-small) for non-SLA routes, C) temporarily increase dedicated pool by 2 nodes if infra approves. Priorities: stability > latency.
Jason SRE: Kicking traffic policy change now — routing 20% non-SLA traffic to eu-west-2. Command run: ```infractl route set --policy eu-west-1->eu-west-2 --percent 20 --filter "!sla_premium"```
Anna M (oncall): Applying canary switch to degraded model for /v1/embeddings (non-premium) -> `model: v2025-embed-small`
Oliver Eng: Added a runtime flag to skip long pre-tokenization heuristics for small inputs. Deploying patch to inference runtime (canary 10%).
status-bot: DRAFT status page entry prepared. Copy below.
Anna M (oncall): Please review and approve, I will publish once wording looks good.
status-bot: ```Status: Partial service degradation in eu-west-1
Impact: Increased latency and intermittent timeouts for chat and embeddings endpoints affecting some customers in EU.
Scope: Non-zero percentage of requests see elevated p95/p99 latency; premium SLA routes largely unaffected so far.
Mitigation: Traffic is being routed to alternative region for non-SLA traffic; canary fallback to smaller model variants enabled; autoscaling in progress.
ETA: 30-45 minutes for full mitigation, monitoring.
Updates: (1) 00:06 - Canary routing applied; (2) 00:18 - Degraded model fallback enabled; (3) 00:40 - autoscale nodes added.```
Priya PM: Suggest adding a short customer-facing blurb for email/console: "We're aware of increased latency in EU and are routing traffic to reduce impact. No data loss. We're working on restoring normal performance."
Anna M (oncall): Draft customer message for high-touch accounts: ```Hi <CustomerName>,
We've detected elevated latency for some requests routed through eu-west-1 and have applied temporary routing and model fallbacks to reduce impact. You should see reduced errors and latency within ~30-45 minutes. No data was lost. We'll follow up when everything is back to normal. — Redwood Inference Ops```
Jason SRE: Infra approved +2 dedicated nodes in eu-west-1; provisioning started (estimate 7-12 min).
Oliver Eng: Observability: p99 dropped from 9.8s -> 5.2s after routing change for non-SLA traffic. Errors (504) reduced by ~40%. Embedding throughput still below baseline for large batches.
Anna M (oncall): Good signal. Keep the routing and fallback in place until autoscale completes and we confirm stable p99 < 2s for 10 minutes.
Jason SRE: Autoscale nodes reported healthy at 1768001600, kube pods draining on old nodes.
status-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATE PUBLISHED at 1768001650.
Anna M (oncall): I'll send the customer notifications for the 3 open tickets with the tailored message. @support-agent please prepare escalation list for any customers who call in.
support-agent: Done, escalation list ready and CS on standby.
Oliver Eng: Follow-up action: open an eval to identify tokenization regressions in v2025-chat-large. Tagging bench-team and runtime-team for investigation.
Priya PM: Noted — can we draft a short internal postmortem template now? We'll add timeline and actions later.
Anna M (oncall): Quick internal note I'll add to the incident channel after the page is resolved: ```- Timeline of events (root alert -> mitigations)
- Customer impact summary
- Root cause hypothesis: model preprocessing regressions + insufficient autoscale headroom for this workload
- Immediate mitigations taken
- Long-term actions: tokenization optimization, autoscale policy review, capacity floor for eu-west-1
- Owner assignments and ETA```
Jason SRE: Current ask: keep routing rule for 20% until we confirm stability for 30min after autoscale; then scale back gradually.
Anna M (oncall): Agree. I'll be on the thread until we hit steady state. Anybody else need to add?
Priya PM: I'll notify account managers for larger customers.
Oliver Eng: I'll start the tokenization bisect; putting a label on the problematic commits.
Anna M (oncall): Closing loop: at 1768002025 observed p99 1.8s across endpoints in eu-west-1 for 15m. Errors returned to baseline. Will snapshot metrics and start RCA doc.
status-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED at 1768002030. Post-incident report scheduled.
Jason SRE: Thanks team. I will follow up with a short runbook update to avoid slow autoscale recovery in the future.
Anna M (oncall): Thanks all. Leaving a note: handoff to next oncall (Jason) at 1768002045.
Jason SRE: Taking handoff. Closing the active incident channel in 15 min unless there are regressions. :white_check_mark:
